The *Paccuppannātītavāra* (Ya 10.3.4) is a textual division belonging to the *Yamaka*, the sixth book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Specifically located within the tenth chapter of the work, it deals with temporal determinations involving the present and the past (*paccuppanna-atīta*). The SuttaCentral database records one translation of the text in one language, with no formal English translation title supplied [SuttaCentral].
